convention.dynamic: Razor model interpolation appended to base id, e.g. product-card-<ItemId>

layout.layout-global-loader: div#global-loader - JS overlay removed on window load; wait-for-app-ready sync point

nav.nav-account-link: header account link (Welcome, <storeName> when logged in / My Account when logged out - state-dependent, dynamic text)
nav.nav-search-clear: icon-only clear button in search box (no accessible name, JS-driven visibility)
nav.nav-search-suggestions: JS-injected search suggestions dropdown container (structural scoping)
nav.nav-cart-count: span#cartCount - dynamic cart badge updated by cart.js
nav.nav-content-popup-title: dynamic popup heading populated by contentPopup.js

footer.footer-logo: footer logo link (img has empty alt - no accessible name)

index.index-category-<sectionKey>: home catalog section wrapper (repeating Razor loop); sectionKey is the IndexModel.Sections dictionary key lower-kebab-cased, e.g. index-category-best-selling-lps
index.index-category-title: section heading inside index-category-* wrapper (dynamic DB text)

components.product-card-preview-<ItemId>: icon-only audio preview link (conditional on Mp3fileCompleted=Y)
components.product-card-cart-<ItemId>: cart action wrapper (was id=btn-container-<ItemId>; id retained)
